text:
elena: Hey folks — seeing a spike in 502/504s from edge in us-east starting ~11:00. Need the best dashboards/queries to correlate request timeouts, nginx upstream 502s, and traces so I can add to the incident note.
aj: Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/edge-errors — use var-region=us-east. Panels: 5xx rate, upstream_timeout count, p95 latency. Loki quick query to surface timeouts:
```
{app="edge",env="prod"} |= "upstream timed out" | count_over_time(1m)
```
That gives a per-minute spike count.
tony: For traces, click the trace icon on the grafana panel (opens Tempo). Or search Tempo/Jaeger: service=edge and look for spans with http.status_code=502 or span.error. If you have a trace_id in logs you can open direct: https://tempo.internal/trace/<trace_id>
srebot: deploy-bot: rollout edge-service@revision-2025-11-05T10:54Z deployed by @ci (stable) — tags: canary=false
elena: ah — deploy at ~10:54 might coincide. Also wondering if this is overload vs bad upstream. Can someone check ingress node cpu/conn counts and any evictions? Link infra dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/infra-nodes?var-cluster=prod-us-east
sam: Datadog quick metric to compute 5xx rate: 
```
avg(last_5m):sum:nginx.http.status.5xx{env:prod,region:us-east} / sum:nginx.http.requests{env:prod,region:us-east} > 0.005
```
Use that if you're tuning alerts.
aj: Current alert 'edge-5xx-rate' is set to 0.002 for 3m — pretty sensitive. I suggest bump to 0.005 and add a secondary sustained alert >0.01 for 5m before paging.
elena: sounds reasonable. Can you open the PR against monitor-alerts with the change and runbook link?
aj: on it. Draft will include: bump threshold, add runbook link, and mute window during investigations. Assigning @tony for review.
ton y: quick log sniff — I'm seeing a lot of `connection_reset_by_peer` from the upstream LB in the same minute buckets as the 502s. Could be LB dropping idle conns after the deploy. I pinged #eng-infra.
irfan: infra checking LB healthchecks and target group metrics now. will post findings in ~10m.
elena: if infra confirms upstream flaps, let's temporarily mute the low-threshold alert for 15m so we don't alert on the rollback/mitigation noise. Also add a note in the incident timeline.
sam: muted alert for 15m: `/alerts mute edge-5xx-rate --until 15m --reason "investigating deploy/upstream"` — will update if infra asks us to extend.
elena: thanks all. Keep updates here. If anyone finds a representative trace_id or a sample log line, paste it here and I'll add to the ticket. :thumbsup:
